bull_bear.body:
- Diversified formulations portfolio across therapeutic areas and dosage forms incl. sterile injectables
- Internationally accredited facilities (TGA-Australia, WHO-GMP, PIC/S) enabling Regulated-market exports
- Growing CDMO vertical (5.5% of revenue FY23 to 19.7% FY25)
- Inorganic expansion (Revat Labs, Noumed Australia/NZ)
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Drug-quality / regulatory proceedings — Criminal proceedings alleging manufacture/sale of not-of-standard-quality products (Drugs & Cosmetics Act)
- Accreditation dependence — Export business depends on maintaining TGA/WHO-GMP/PIC/S accreditations
- Acquisition integration — Noumed (Australia/NZ) integration and funding via bridge/term loans
- Customer concentration — Reliance on government agencies and institutional buyers
- Related-party dependence — Registered office leased from promoter-director Aruna Karusala
- Working capital intensity — Institutional/tender sales lengthen receivables
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Sai Parenteral is a diversified pharma formulations company operating in (i) Branded Generic Formulations sold under its own brands to government agencies, pharma companies, hospitals and super-stockists, and (ii) CDMO products & services (product development, validation, stability studies, dossiers, regulatory filings, commercial manufacturing) for domestic and international (Regulated and Semi-Regulated) markets. It owns 5 manufacturing facilities in India and acquired a 74.60% stake in Noumed Pharmaceuticals (Australia/NZ) in November 2025.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Branded Generic Formulations:** Cardiovascular, Neuropsychiatry, Anti-diabetic, Respiratory, Antibiotics, Gastroenterology, VMS, Analgesics, Dermatology
- **Dosage forms:** Injectables (dry powder, pre-filled syringes, ampoules, vials), Tablets, Capsules, Liquid orals, Dry syrups, Ointments
- **CDMO:** Product development, Validation batches, Stability studies, Dossier compilation, Regulatory filings, Commercial manufacturing
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:
- Revat Laboratories Private Limited — Wholly owned subsidiary: GMP unit at Ongole, AP; acquired Feb 2024
- Sai Parenterals Pte Limited (Singapore) — Wholly owned subsidiary: Acquisition vehicle for Noumed
- Noumed Pharmaceuticals Pty Limited (Australia) — 74.60% subsidiary: OTC pharma; acquired Nov 12, 2025; NZ ops via Noumed Pharmaceuticals Limited
business.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
